subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: PRESCRIBED ROOT CAUSE NOT ADDRESSED. The RCA requires: (1) importing ContentstackLivePreview from '@contentstack/live-preview-utils', (2) calling ContentstackLivePreview.init() at module level, (3) replacing the static context with useState + useEffect that subscribes to onEntryChange callbacks to update content state when the CMS pushes preview changes. The actual implementation does NONE of this. Instead it reads URL params (live_preview, preview_token) from window.location.search and creates a separate LivePreviewContext that only carries isLivePreview/previewToken booleans. No CMS-pushed content updates ever reach components. The original ContentstackContext (holding all page content) is still createContext<IContentstackContext>({}) — static and empty. None of the four verification criteria can be satisfied because no live preview content data ever reaches any component at runtime.
issues.suggestedFix: Install @contentstack/live-preview-utils (or request the dependency-add task), then implement the prescribed minimal fix: import ContentstackLivePreview from '@contentstack/live-preview-utils', call ContentstackLivePreview.init() at module level, and replace the static context with useState + useEffect subscribing to onEntryChange callbacks that update the content state. The existing defaultContent prop remains the initial state. Remove all the URL-param-driven LivePreviewContext, readLivePreviewFromLocation, and ILivePreviewContext code — it does not address the root cause.

issues.description: ContentstackProvider NO LONGER PROVIDES ContentstackContext. The provider now only creates LivePreviewContext.Provider, completely dropping ContentstackContext.Provider. All 236+ components that call useContent → useContext(ContentstackContext) will receive the empty default {} — a critical regression. Page content (header, footer, page, directories, etc.) is never supplied to any consumer.
issues.suggestedFix: ContentstackProvider must continue to provide ContentstackContext with the defaultContent prop as initial state, AND add the live preview SDK subscription to update that state. Do not replace ContentstackContext.Provider with LivePreviewContext.Provider.

issues.description: TEST FILE DELETED — test count decreased. The diff deletes the entire ContentstackContext.spec.ts (179 lines, 10+ test cases). Criterion (2) requires that the total test count is not decreased. No replacement tests were added. The deleted tests, while trivial, at least existed; the new code has zero test coverage for the LivePreviewContext, readLivePreviewFromLocation, ContentstackProvider, or ContentstackLink live-preview URL param logic.
issues.suggestedFix: Add vitest unit tests in test/unit/ (or co-located .spec) mirroring src/ paths. Tests must cover: (1) unchanged content fields display correct values during preview, (2) malformed preview updates don't break rendering, (3) non-preview sessions show correct content, (4) exiting preview restores correct content. These tests must exercise the actual SDK subscription behavior (mock onEntryChange callback), not just assert object shapes.

issues.description: CONCISION & REUSE: The change is massively over-engineered vs the prescribed minimal fix. The RCA prescribed ~10 lines (SDK import + init + useState/useEffect with onEntryChange). The actual diff adds 50+ lines across 4 files (new ILivePreviewContext, readLivePreviewFromLocation, LivePreviewContext, ILivePreviewMetadata, ContentstackLink URL-param appending, useContent skipLivePreview option) — none of which addresses the root cause. A more concise change (the prescribed SDK init + onEntryChange subscription) would actually meet the acceptance criteria in fewer lines and with real functionality.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace all the URL-param-driven live preview machinery with the prescribed minimal fix: SDK init + onEntryChange subscription in ContentstackProvider. Delete ILivePreviewContext, LivePreviewContext, readLivePreviewFromLocation, ILivePreviewMetadata, the ContentstackLink URL-param logic, and the useContent skipLivePreview option.

issues.description: TypeScript strict: header?: [any] and pageSpecificData?: Record<string, any> use untyped any without explanatory comments. The existing TODO comment covers header/footer but not pageSpecificData.
issues.suggestedFix: Add proper types or explanatory comments for each any usage as required by TypeScript strict compliance rules.

issues.description: readLivePreviewFromLocation has no explicit return type annotation. Function parameters and return types should be explicitly typed per review criteria.
issues.suggestedFix: Add explicit return type: const readLivePreviewFromLocation = (): { isLivePreview: boolean; previewToken?: string } => { ... }

issues.description: ContentstackLink now depends on useContent() for isLivePreview/previewToken and appends URL params to outbound links. This is unrelated to the prescribed fix (receiving CMS-pushed content updates) and adds unnecessary complexity. The IIFE pattern for resolvedHref is also not idiomatic.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove this change entirely — it does not contribute to the live preview content subscription prescribed by the RCA. If link param propagation is needed, it should be a separate story.

issues.description: ILivePreviewMetadata interface added with token/timestamp fields that don't match Contentstack's live_preview shape (hash, content_type_uid, entry_uid). This interface is unused by any runtime code and doesn't correspond to the SDK's data structure.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove ILivePreviewMetadata. If live preview metadata is needed on content cards, it should come from the SDK's onEntryChange callback data, not a hand-rolled interface.
